blocker.summary: POST/GET /api/workflow/epics fail because WorkflowStore persists via DopeconBridge custom_data which cannot reach a ConPort REST custom_data API.
evidence: GET /api/workflow/epics -> 503 DopeconBridge error (401) Not authenticated (missing DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN on task-orchestrator)
After JWT to bridge: GET /kg/custom_data -> 500 ClientConnectorError conport:3004 Connection refused
Inside network: conport TCP 3004 refused; 3005/4005 open
conport:3005 is MCP SSE surface, not REST custom_data
Bridge default CONPORT_URL=http://conport:3004; running bridge env lacks CONPORT_URL override
required_remediation: Expose ConPort REST custom_data (or re-point WorkflowStore to a live store)
Set DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN on task-orchestrator from bridge /auth/token
Align CONPORT_URL in dopecon-bridge with listening REST port
